summary: Full v2.2 verification (backend + frontend). All 50 backend pytest pass (20 new v2.2 + 30 regression). Frontend verified: mobile hero compact (products visible after y=600 scroll with 4 of 10 cards in view, hero+grid_top=705px in a 844px viewport), 4-stat mobile strip rendered as compact row, testimonials carousel auto-slides (.animate-slide-left with animationName=slide-left, 35s duration, 10 children for seamless loop), admin button completely hidden when not logged in (display:none) AND when non-admin Google user (test.reviewer@coolbreeze.pk) is signed in, AdminLoginPage 3-mode flow works (login→forgot→reset with 6-digit code input, new+confirm password fields, mismatched-password error 'Passwords do not match' shows), multi-admin login: all 3 allowed gmails (ockmicrosoft.games, tradebyabdul, royalu101) authenticate with shared 'Anees@3221.' and redirect to /admin/dashboard, AdminDashboard Site Content tab → 'Customer Testimonials (auto-sliding carousel)' editor with 5 seed rows, +Add Testimonial increments row count, name/city/date(date picker)/stars(1-5 select)/avatar/quote fields all editable, Save Testimonials button present, Admin Review form now correctly renders <input type='datetime-local' data-testid='admin-review-date'> labelled 'Review Date & Time (optional override)' — the iteration_4 bug is FIXED. Backend: /admin/check-access returns 401 unauth / {is_admin:false,email:test.reviewer@coolbreeze.pk} for non-admin / {is_admin:true} for allowed admin; /admin/forgot-password creates bcrypt-hashed code in db.admin_reset_codes with 15min expiry, returns generic message in <5s even when Resend send fails for unverified sandbox emails, doesn't leak whether email exists; /admin/reset-password rejects short pw (400), invalid code (400, increments attempts), expired code (400 + deletes record), >=5 attempts (429), and on success updates db.admins.password_hash + deletes reset record + allows immediate login with new password; PUT /admin/testimonials replaces featured_testimonials and GET /api/site-settings reflects it; PUT requires admin JWT (401 without).

design_issues.screen: AdminDashboard.jsx Site Content tab — testimonial star select (line ~862)
issues: React dev-time hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Cosmetic only (caused by editor instrumentation injecting <span style="display:contents"> wrapper inside <option>). Does not affect functionality. Cleanup recommended but non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: Email enumeration is correctly prevented: /admin/forgot-password returns the same generic message regardless of whether email exists in admins, and only creates a reset record when admin is found (verified by DB inspection in test_forgot_password_returns_generic_for_unknown_email).
Reset code is bcrypt-hashed in db.admin_reset_codes.code_hash ($2b$...) — never stored plaintext.
Brute-force protection: attempts counter increments per invalid code; after 5 returns 429. Expired codes are auto-deleted.
Non-blocking email send: /admin/forgot-password completes in <5s even when Resend send fails (verified via asyncio.to_thread wrapper at server.py L619).
/admin/testimonials properly gated by admin JWT (returns 401/403 without token).
Admin link hidden via Tailwind 'hidden' class + conditional 'lg:flex' / mobile 'hidden' — verified display:none for both unauthenticated and non-admin Google user.
Mobile hero compact refactor works: py-8 on mobile reduces hero footprint so products-grid sits at ~705px (vs 844px viewport), and 4 product cards visible at scroll y=600.
Testimonials carousel uses 35s slide-left animation with 10 duplicated children for seamless infinite loop.
Minor: React dev warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' is from editor instrumentation, not source code; safe to ignore in production builds.
